Diameter 2.93 in = the embroidered seal measured on Figure 5.5 (the printed polo has no figure of its own and no photograph is on disk; ESTIMATE that the print is the same size), centred on the wearer's left breast at the mirror of the embroidered seal's position about the centre line (print_seal_slot of garment-polo-male).
